svg.title: 01 Market state is a belief
svg.desc: Observed synthetic index log returns and the conditional probability of the stress state, before and after each observation. The true state strip is available only from the simulator.
svg.text: SYNTHETIC DATA · Forward filtering only · Gaussian emissions · Fixed model parameters
Simulator state: teal = calm; orange = stress. This strip is not supplied to the filter.
Prior probabilities precede the observation; posterior probabilities include it. No backward smoothing or future observations.
The emissions and transition model are supplied assumptions. Belief concentration does not prove the model describes a real market.
